body:
### 中文更新日志
* **重要升级提醒**：本次新增「私密相册」完整服务端隔离与鉴权能力，**如需使用私密相册功能，请同步更新 Unraid 端相册容器（`easy-unraid-photos`）至最新版本**。
* **全新「苹果白金轻盈」双端视觉与大屏工作台重塑**：
  * **仪表盘重构**：采用去硬边框纯白柔影视觉语言，接入 Unraid 原版 76 款机箱矢量图标库与 4 款 3D 预设，支持与 Unraid WebUI 机箱外观一比一同步；大屏端重构全高固定侧边栏，同步修复实时网络速率单位在小屏下的截断问题；
  * **Docker 与虚拟机大屏升级**：Docker 页融合三层轻盈卡片与 OrbStack 高密度 6 列列表双视图，分离启停按钮与开机自启动开关消除语义混淆；Docker 容器管控中心与虚拟机管控中心在大屏端重构为居中左右双栏面板，一屏直达全部监控指标与运维入口；
  * **Docker 实时流式更新与后端三层更新提醒**：容器更新升级为实时按层展示下载字节、层数与阶段的平滑进度条，支持后台防重冲突与顶部常驻续接横幅、管控中心原位检测与更新加载反馈；冷启动自动检测智能相册与智能中枢后端容器新版本，在导航栏、设置入口及置顶系统环境卡片中一键直达更新；
  * **全应用大屏悬浮窗与硬件详情双栏**：大屏端所有核心面板与配置弹窗统一升级为居中圆角悬浮模态窗；CPU、内存、UPS、GPU、网络接口与系统核心服务 6 大硬件详情窗重构为大屏双栏/多列布局，GPU 核心负载升级为按卡独立记录的 24 点实时历史趋势曲线；
  * **智能中枢 UI 全面统一**：中枢首页接入真实硬件时序采样波形，服务健康哨兵、硬件时序看板、网络质量测速、AI 弹幕同传工作台在大屏端升级为多列/左右双栏工作台。
* **智能相册「私密相册」全链路闭环**：
  * 支持原文件无损隐藏隔离、独立 Vault Token 硬鉴权与防窥模糊锁，与 AI 聚类、宝宝相册、回收站及本地缓存完全物理隔离；
  * 支持按日期分组时间轴、照片/视频筛选、按日勾选、大屏拖拽直传与双端响应式适配；
  * 统一相册缩略图桌面悬停微放大、Hero 转场，并彻底修复开启批量选择时因动画曲线嵌套过冲引发的全端 Release 卡死问题。
* **文件管理器全格式预览、离线办公与极速引擎**：
  * **纯客户端离线 Office 套件**：新增 Word / Excel / PPT / CSV 离线预览与安全编辑能力，支持桌面端调用本机软件编辑后自动回传；
  * **阅读体验增强**：内置 PDF 预览器启用原生力度惯性滚动并新增右侧悬浮页码抓手；长文本预览支持 GBK/UTF-16 自动编码识别与右侧快速滑动抓手；修复 Android 端 Office 预览返回掉帧；
  * **SFTP 极速引擎与四端硬件视频抽帧**：优化单 RTT 列目录、持久化 SWR 快照与骨架屏，消除桌面端 300ms 点击延迟；补齐 Android / iOS / macOS / Windows 四端纯客户端视频硬件按需抽帧与 Rust `native_sftp` 全四端二进制同步更新；统一文件管理响应断点至 `800px` 消除 iPad 竖屏触发旧版抽屉的断层；侧边栏与移动端快捷入口统一升级为「配置目录（`/boot/config`）」。
* **全平台稳定性与授权加固**：
  * 加固云端多机授权状态同步、冷启动防串权与离线缓存逻辑；
  * 修复官方支持弹窗历史消息跳动回弹、macOS 浏览器拉起回退与全端体验体检发现的多项边界隐患。

### English Changelog
* **Important Upgrade Notice**: This release introduces full server-side isolation and authentication for Private Vault. **Please update your `easy-unraid-photos` container on Unraid to the latest version** to enable Private Vault features.
* **Apple Platinum Light Redesign & Desktop Split-Pane Workspaces**:
  * **Dashboard Overhaul**: Adopted a borderless soft-shadow Apple Platinum visual language with Unraid's native 76-icon chassis font and 4 built-in 3D presets synchronized 1:1 with Unraid WebUI; rebuilt desktop full-height pinned navigation rail and resolved mobile network rate unit truncation;
  * **Docker & VM Desktop Upgrade**: Combined three-layer cards with a high-density 6-column OrbStack table view in Docker, decoupled power controls from autostart toggles, and redesigned both Docker Container and VM Control Centers into zero-scroll split-pane floating dialogs on desktop;
  * **Real-Time Streaming Docker Pull & Backend Update Badges**: Upgraded container updates with real-time per-layer download byte/phase progress, duplicate-run protection, and an auto-reattaching background progress banner; added cold-start three-layer update badges and top settings update cards for Photos and Hub backend containers;
  * **Unified Desktop Floating Modals & Hardware Inspectors**: Automatically adapted core sheets and utility modals into centered floating windows on wide screens (`>= 800px`), redesigned CPU, Memory, UPS, GPU, Network, and Core Services detail panels into dual-column desktop views, and upgraded GPU core load to a per-PCI 24-point real-time waveform;
  * **Smart Hub UI Unification**: Connected real-time telemetry sparklines to Hub Home and upgraded Health Sentinel, Metrics Monitor, Network Speedtest, and AI Live Caption Studio to desktop multi-column/split-pane workspaces.
* **Private Vault End-to-End Pipeline**:
  * Added lossless hidden-storage isolation, dedicated Vault Token authentication, and privacy blur lock completely isolated from AI clustering, Baby Album, Trash, and local caches;
  * Supported date-grouped timelines, photo/video filters, desktop drag-and-drop direct import, hover zoom & Hero transitions, and fixed a critical Release-mode UI freeze caused by nested overshooting animation curves when entering batch selection.
* **File Manager Offline Office Suite & High-Speed Engine**:
  * **Client-Side Offline Office Suite**: Added offline preview and safe editing for Word, Excel, PPT, and CSV files, including automatic sync-back after desktop native editing;
  * **Enhanced Readers**: Enabled native momentum scrolling and floating page scrubber for PDFs, GBK/UTF-16 auto-detection and fast scrollbar for text files, and smooth back-navigation transitions for Android Office previews;
  * **SFTP Turbo & 4-Platform Hardware Video Thumbnails**: Added single-RTT directory listing, SWR snapshots, 0ms desktop selection, unified `800px` responsive breakpoint eliminating the legacy iPad portrait drawer, and cross-platform on-demand hardware video frame extraction across Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows with updated Rust `native_sftp` binaries.
* **Cross-Platform Stability & Licensing Hardening**:
  * Hardened multi-server license sync, cold-start isolation, support chat scroll anchoring, macOS external URL fallback, and dozens of cross-platform audit fixes.
